players.product: intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) individualized neoantigen therapy, jointly developed with Merck

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release: revenue was $87 million in the U.S. and $58 million in international markets; lower COVID vaccine sales in the U.S. and South America were offset by deliveries in the United Kingdom under a long-term strategic government partnership and higher stand-ready manufacturing and collaboration revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue: $87 million U.S., $58 million international

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release, intismeran autogene (with Merck): Moderna presented positive five-year Phase 2b adjuvant melanoma data at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting showing a sustained benefit, with intismeran in combination with KEYTRUDA reducing the risk of recurrence or death by 49% compared to KEYTRUDA alone. The Phase 2 adjuvant muscle invasive bladder cancer study is fully enrolled (as are the Phase 3 adjuvant melanoma and Phase 2 adjuvant renal cell carcinoma studies).
quarterly_data.figure: 49% reduction in risk of recurrence or death (five-year Phase 2b adjuvant melanoma)
